type.provenance: Prohibits sale, manufacture, distribution, and use of firefighting foam containing intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.

date.provenance: Beginning two years after the effective date of this act

who.provenance: no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State

action.provenance: no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State

products.provenance: class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS

value: The sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law or regulation
exceptions.provenance: Subsection a. of this section shall not apply to the sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law, or by a rule or regulation adopted pursuant thereto

intentionally_added.provenance: firefighting foam containing intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
